sender_role: Fractional COO | Operations Consultant | Transformation Partner
sender_summary: Chris Ringenberg is an experienced Fractional COO and Operations Consultant who embeds with real estate investment and private equity firms to build scalable operational infrastructure. He specializes in portfolio operations architecture, cross-functional process design, and leading transformation initiatives for asset-heavy organizations navigating growth. Chris works with leadership teams who have a clear acquisition and development thesis but need operational depth to execute it consistently — building the systems, reporting frameworks, and team structures that turn strategy into performance.
receiver_role: Managing Director - Head of Asset and Portfolio Management
receiver_summary: Stephen Orullian is the Managing Director and Head of Asset and Portfolio Management at BMC Investments, a Denver-based commercial real estate investment and development firm active across multifamily and mixed-use assets in the Mountain West and Sun Belt. In his role, Stephen owns the operational and financial performance of BMC's entire portfolio — overseeing NOI optimization, capex planning, budget variance analysis, third-party property manager relationships, and value-add execution across properties. He bridges acquisitions, development, and capital markets teams, ensuring that assets perform against underwriting and that portfolio-level decisions are grounded in real-time operational data. As BMC's portfolio scales, his challenge is building the operational infrastructure — systems, processes, reporting, and team capacity — to manage growing complexity without a proportional increase in overhead.
outreach_goal: Book a 20-minute discovery conversation to explore whether Chris's Fractional COO model can help BMC Investments build the operational infrastructure needed to manage a scaling portfolio more efficiently
offer: Chris Ringenberg offers embedded Fractional COO and operational consulting engagements for real estate investment firms. The work is not advisory — it is execution-focused operational leadership that sits inside the organization. Engagements are scoped around specific outcomes: building asset management reporting systems, standardizing operating procedures across a portfolio, building out team structure and capacity, or leading a defined transformation initiative. For real estate firms managing growing asset bases, Chris provides the senior operational depth to match the pace of the investment strategy — without the cost or commitment of a full-time COO hire.
asset_name: The Portfolio Operations Maturity Framework — a diagnostic tool for real estate investment firms scaling from 10 to 50+ assets
pain_points: Portfolio growth is outpacing the operational infrastructure to manage it — reporting is fragmented, processes are ad-hoc, and decisions are slower than the pace of acquisitions demands, Asset management performance data is siloed across properties and operators — no consolidated visibility makes portfolio-level pattern recognition and capital allocation decisions harder than they need to be, The team doing the work today was built for a smaller portfolio — scaling without rebuilding the operational model creates compounding inefficiency that erodes returns
tone: Executive-level and consultative — peer-to-peer between two operational leaders, direct and insight-first, no fluff, no generic compliments, specific to real estate investment operations
